This application coming on for admission this day, the  following:
 ORDER

This application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"It is therefore, prayed that the F.I.R. Dated 24.02.2023 in Crime No.0018/2023 by which the applicants has been alleged for offence under Section 498A, 34 of I.P.C. be quashed in the aforesaid submission of the Hon'ble apex court in the larger interest of justice.

Any other order or orders which this Hon'ble Highcourt deems fit and proper in the facts and circumstances may also be passed in the favor of the applicants."
2.
It is fairly conceded by counsel for applicants that the applicants have not filed the MLC report of Pallavi and others.
Accordingly, he seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application with liberty to file a properly constituted application with MLC reports.
3. With aforesaid liberty, the application is dismissed as withdrawn.
